description: List registered OBSBOT Tail 2 cameras (network cameras; MAC-keyed). Each entry: mac (the identity — pass it as `camera` to any obsbot_tail2_* tool), name, and the host(s) it has answered on. Registration is not liveness: an offline camera still appears here; use obsbot_tail2_status to check one is reachable.
name: obsbot_tail2_devices
